//: Airtable CSV export, a dialect importer: one `file` job that reads the export, splits comma-joined multi-selects and linked-record names into lists, reduces attachments to their URLs, and hands core the grid through the Import port (D39 as amended). Core maps, previews and commits it like a hand-mapped CSV; the plugin never writes a record. Depends on @spaces/sdk only; effect and zod are peers the host provides.
name: @spaces/plugin-airtable
